body:
Zenithium is a mod based on a new dimension (crafting, building, OP entities) with a slightly fantastical atmosphere.
travel Portal zenithium in overworld and join this Dimension, explore new biomes and craft you special Items,
New Armors and armor Trims                                                       
New Ores : Zenithium , Gamma, Carmine, Opal                                                                               
New Tools and Weapons
